newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weakens vs dollar, pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weakens vs dollar, pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee was fixed weaker against both the dollar and the pound sterling on Thursday, reflecting international market trends, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was quoted at a commercial mean rate of 20.9675 to the dollar from 20.9275 on Wednesday, and at 35.0855 to the pound sterling from 34.7175.
"The dollar and pound continued strengthening on the international markets, that's why we cannot expect a strong rupee," a dealer said.
Forex dealers said the central bank sold dollars on the forex interbank market on Wednesday afternoon at the prevailing interbank rate.
